title: Brass Knuckles
caption: Maximalist trap anthem, colossal detuned synth-brass fanfares stabbing like a marching band from the future, a sped-up, pitched-high soul singer sample chopped into a looping hook, booming distorted 808 bass slides, half-time drums with rattling triplet hi-hats and a snare like a gunshot, orchestral hits and glittering arpeggios. Every element is too loud and too bright on purpose. Triumphant, ridiculous, euphoric, stadium-sized, a victory lap.
